inputs.name: osquery_version
inputs.description: osquery release to install, such as "5.24.0". Raising it upgrades osquery in place.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: osquery options for the config's options section, such as { schedule_splay_percent = "10", host_identifier = "uuid" }.

inputs.name: schedule
inputs.description: Scheduled queries, by name, such as { os_version = { query = "SELECT * FROM os_version;", interval = 3600 } }. interval is in seconds. snapshot = true logs the whole result each time to the snapshots log, rather than what changed to the results log.

inputs.name: packs
inputs.description: Query packs osquery ships, by name, such as ["incident-response", "ossec-rootkit"]. They're read from /opt/osquery/share/osquery/packs.

inputs.name: custom_packs
inputs.description: Packs of your own, by name, written into the config. Each has queries, like schedule, and optionally platform, such as "linux", and discovery, a list of queries that must all return rows for the pack to run.

inputs.name: file_paths
inputs.description: File integrity monitoring: paths to watch, by category, such as { etc = ["/etc/%%"], ssh = ["/root/.ssh/%%"] }. % matches within a directory, %% recursively. When set, the circuit turns on file events and schedules a file_events query.

inputs.name: file_events_interval
inputs.description: Seconds between runs of the file_events query that logs file changes, when file_paths is set.

inputs.name: log_rotate_size
inputs.description: Size in bytes at which osquery rotates its results and snapshots logs in /var/log/osquery. The default is 25 MiB.

inputs.name: log_rotate_max_files
inputs.description: Rotated logs osquery keeps of each kind before deleting the oldest.

inputs.name: fleet
inputs.type:
object({
    address              = string
    server_certs         = optional(string)
    host_identifier      = optional(string, "uuid")
    config_refresh       = optional(number, 10)
    distributed_interval = optional(number, 10)
  })
inputs.description: A Fleet server to enroll with, such as { address = "fleet.example.com:8080", server_certs = "/etc/osquery/fleet.pem" }. server_certs is a CA bundle already on the host; when null, osquery's own bundle of public CAs. Fleet then supplies the config, and results go to Fleet as well as the local log. Needs enroll_secret.

inputs.name: enroll_secret
inputs.description: Fleet enroll secret, when fleet is set. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_enroll_secret; it never reaches state or the plan.
